_comment: Fences that close off what the player may not enter (tool frame: x east, z north, metres from the statue). points: the fence line; style: 'site' (mesh construction panels on concrete feet), tarp: true hangs a white tarp on them; height in metres; panel: max panel width. Exported to city.json `fences` (tool/export_web.dart), built by web3d/src/fences.ts. Places behind a fence get low-resolution pictures only. style 'roadblock': site panels plus red-white barrier boards, lamps and cones; `wall` (metres) raises the collider into an invisible wall that many metres tall. (The first Kaptol roadblock, on the private road north of the wall, was removed 2026-09-30: that road, its gates and Ribnjak park are open. Since 2026-10-01 a roadblock closes Kaptol itself just north of the Domitrovićeva kula gate, and the Cathedral's north side is fenced like its south side, so the precinct inside the walls behind the Cathedral is closed.) Roadblock cones stand on the right-hand side of the direction the points run.

fences.name: Cathedral, south side (between the south tower and the Archbishop's palace)
fences.source: White tarp-covered site fence by the palace garden, Street View Jul 2024 (pano 2 Kaptol)

fences.name: Cathedral, north side (between the north tower and the north wall)
fences.source: Mirrors the south side's tarp fence; closes the precinct inside the walls behind the Cathedral (user request 2026-10-01)

fences.name: Kaptol roadblock north of the Domitrovićeva kula gate (seminary palace to the canons' house opposite)
fences.source: User request 2026-10-01: lock the playable area north of the Cathedral right after the gate; runs west to east so the cones face south, the gate and the roundabout's south half stay open

fences.name: Uspinjača street (Ulica Josipa Eugena Tomića) roadblock, 5 m in from Ilica
fences.source: User request 2026-10-01: the street up to the funicular is scenery only; closed just past the corner of Mango (Ilica 12). Runs west to east so the cones face Ilica

fences.name: Tkalčićeva roadblock before the Cesarec bust
fences.source: User request 2026-10-02: Tkalčićeva closed near the end of the map, just before the August Cesarec bust. Runs west to east so the cones face south

fences.name: Pavla Radića roadblock just north of Kravata (Radiona and the street end behind it closed)
fences.source: User request 2026-10-02: closed a few metres past Kravata (Pavla Radića 21, ends z 261); Radiona is removed from the deliveries. Runs west to east so the cones face south

fences.name: Pavla Radića, side path opposite the Selfie & Memories Museum
fences.source: User request 2026-10-02: the open path on the west side across from the museum, closed ~5 m in. Runs south to north so the cones face the street

fences.name: Ilica, side path opposite Calliope and Farmacia (towards the funicular)
fences.source: User request 2026-10-02: the passage on the north side of Ilica opposite Ilica 11, open for ~5 m then closed. Runs west to east so the cones face Ilica
